$comment: Anvaya University's programme catalogue: the single source of truth for both the page and the brain. Fictional. Fees are per year in INR (fee_total = fee_per_year x duration in years; under a year, the whole fee). Dates are DD MMM YYYY.

schools.name: School of Engineering & Technology
schools.blurb: Labs-first engineering: every B.Tech student ships a funded project with an industry mentor before graduating.

schools.name: Anvaya School of Business
schools.blurb: Case-led management education with a live consulting project in every year of study.

schools.name: School of Design
schools.blurb: Studio culture, open 24 hours, with makers' labs for wood, metal, textile and digital fabrication.

schools.name: School of Law
schools.blurb: Moot courts, legal aid clinics and a mandatory chambers internship every summer.

schools.name: School of Health Sciences
schools.blurb: Clinical training at the 400-bed Anvaya teaching hospital, a ten-minute walk from the classrooms.

schools.name: School of Liberal Arts & Sciences
schools.blurb: Major in one discipline, minor in another, and write a research thesis in the honours year.

schools.name: Anvaya Online & Executive Education
schools.blurb: Degrees and certificates built for working people: live weekend classes, recorded lectures, the same faculty.

scholarships.name: Udaan Need-based Scholarship

scholarships.basis: Automatic for women admitted to these programmes; adds to one other scholarship

scholarships.basis: Representation in a recognised sport in the last three years

scholarships.name: Defence Family Scholarship
scholarships.basis: Children of serving or retired defence and paramilitary personnel

scholarships.name: Online Early-bird Scholarship
scholarships.basis: Paying the full programme fee by the batch deadline

tiers.rule: Full fee paid by the deadline
